newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco to buy KNP BT packaging unit.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco to buy KNP BT packaging unit.

text.p: Tenneco Inc. said Monday it has agreed to purchase the protective and flexible packaging division of Dutch distribution, paper and packaging firm NV Koninklijke KNP BT for about $375 million.

Analysts had expected Tenneco to pay up to $500 million for the division, which includes a protective packaging business in Europe and North America, and a European flexible packaging business, Tenneco spokesman Mike Bazinet said.
The business, which will become part of Tenneco Packaging, accounted for $542 million in 1996 sales.
Greenwich, Conn.-based Tenneco said the purchase more than doubles Tenneco Packaging's sales in Europe and establishes a significant presence in two growth segments of the packaging business.

"Acquiring this part of KNP BT makes us a leader in protective packaging in both the U.S. and Europe," said Paul Stecko, chief operating officer of Tenneco. "Protective packaging will be a primary growth platform for Tenneco Packaging."
Tenneco Chief Executive Dana Mead said the acquisition came at the right price, is an excellent strategic fit and would immediately contribute to net income.
The deal is expected to close by the end of April, subject to European Union regulatory approval.
Tenneco's stock fell 37.5 cents to $39 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
